description: Measures free bytes at a filesystem path (default '/Users') and classifies it ok/warning/critical against two floors (default 100 GiB warning, 50 GiB critical; both overridable per call). On a severity TRANSITION (status differs from the last status an alert was successfully delivered for, including a recovery back to ok) it dispatches plugin::agent_messaging_plugin::peer_send_by_name to a durable role and inspects the delivery result rather than trusting it blind: only delivery in {queued_wake, queued_notification, queued_watcher} counts as reaching a live holder. alert_role has NO baked-in identity default -- it resolves an explicit call-time param, else this plugin's own config key 'alert_role' (plugin.yaml `config:` block, deployment-local, never shipped), else null. With no configured target, or an undelivered send (queued_for_replay, a vacant/malformed role, or any non-completed dispatch), the call still returns the correct measurement and classification, but alerted is false with alert_reason set (alert_target_unconfigured, or the specific delivery-failure reason) and is logged at ERROR; the durable last-notified marker is NOT advanced in either case, so the same transition is retried on the next call rather than silently dropped. Repeated calls at an unchanged status do not re-alert (rate-limited by transition, not by tick) -- the marker lives in StateManagementInterface, not memory, so this holds across process restarts and a stateless cron.
embedding_description: Host disk headroom guard. Measures free disk space at a path and classifies it ok/warning/critical against configurable warning/critical thresholds. On a severity transition it alerts a durable peer-messaging role, inspecting delivery and rate-limiting per transition. Unconfigured or undelivered alerts surface as alerted=false, never silent.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: status (ok|warning|critical), free_bytes, path, transitioned (bool), alerted (bool -- true only on a live-delivered transition alert), alert_role (the role a transition was reported to, or null if no transition this call), alert_reason (set when transitioned is true and alerted is false: e.g. alert_target_unconfigured, or a delivery-failure reason).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with status and free_bytes. If transitioned is true and alerted is false, surface alert_reason prominently -- this means a real severity change had nobody to tell, which is the condition this check exists to prevent going unnoticed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: The check itself failed before completing a measurement or alert attempt (e.g. the state-management call for the durable marker returned a non-completed action_status, or orchestrator_ref was unavailable). Distinct from a completed call reporting alerted=false, which is a normal, fully-handled outcome, not an error.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: A raised exception here means a provider outage (state service) or missing orchestrator wiring, per this platform's fail-loud-on-provider-outage standing guidance -- it is not a signal about disk space itself.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Check that platform_health_plugin's orchestrator_ref is set (platform finished startup) and that the state-management provider is healthy before retrying.
